excerpt: New England Patriots won 26-19. The number landed, and some of the reasoning behind it held up. Take the result; do not take it as confirmation of the parts that did not.

tally.headline: 1 of 10 gradeable claims held up, 0 did not

implied_side.why: EdgeDesk’s own number sat 21.8 points toward New England Patriots of the quote EdgeDesk captured at BetOnline.ag. That is what the disagreement implied. It was published as research, not as a recommendation to bet it.

implied_total.why: EdgeDesk’s fair total of 41.7 sat 1.8 points below the captured total of 43.5.

closing_line.note: The line moved 14.5 points toward the side EdgeDesk’s number leaned before kickoff. That is the market arriving where EdgeDesk already was, and over many games it is the only evidence that a disagreement carried information.

reasons: 0 claims held up, 8 held up in direction only and 0 did not. Parts of the read were right and parts were not.
EdgeDesk projected a home margin of 14.8 and the game finished 7 the home way — 7.8 points of margin error, inside the range the model published.
process.basis: the drivers, matchups and measured advantages only — never the price or the market claim, which are the result in longer words

verdict.line: The number landed, and some of the reasoning behind it held up. Take the result; do not take it as confirmation of the parts that did not.

grading.separation_note: The bet result and the process grade above are computed separately and are allowed to disagree. A winning number with a broken thesis is recorded as exactly that.

lessons.pregame_expectation: 1 of the claims in this article rested on model.
lessons.actual_result: None of them could be graded: no single-game statistic in EdgeDesk’s vocabulary observes this driver.
lessons.lesson: EdgeDesk prices these games partly on signals it has no way to observe afterwards. That is not an error in the model — it is a gap in the audit, and it means the platform cannot tell, from results alone, whether those parts of the number are earning their weight.
lessons.suggested_investigation: Consider whether a postgame data source exists for model.

lessons.pregame_expectation: EdgeDesk makes it New England Patriots −15.0 where the market has New England Patriots −7.0 at BetOnline.ag — a 7.8 points disagreement.
lessons.actual_result: New England Patriots won by 7. the result landed on EdgeDesk’s side of the market number: New England Patriots beat a margin of -7
lessons.lesson: The disagreement landed. One landing proves nothing on its own; the aggregate of them, held against the closing line, is the only thing that would.
